artworks.title: Fiesole, Cloister of S. Domenico
artworks.medium: pen and black ink
artworks.description: The image is a sketch with a bird's-eye view of a complex of buildings with a variety of rooftops that are angled and layered across the composition. The horizon is placed high, offering a distant view of rolling hills, with a small house and a windmill perched on one of them. The drawing is created with quick, loose pen strokes, giving a lively and dynamic feel to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring black ink on a beige background, creating a classic and historical atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a dense arrangement of irregular architectural shapes amid foliage made with looped and jagged lines. Further back, a church with a pointed steeple is central to the surrounding structures. The scene is depicted with contour lines only, without shading, allowing the viewer to imagine the depth and texture within the architecture and landscape.

artworks.title: Piazza S. Spirito, Florence
artworks.medium: pen and black ink
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a church and its surrounding area, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The church features a rounded dome with a spire, a large circular window on its facade. In the background, rooftops, trees, and buildings are less detailed. The drawing uses hatching and bold lines for depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic with a warm tone and dark ink lines. A fountain and stylized palm trees are in the foreground, with steps leading towards them. Further architectural elements and vegetation are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Canal, Venice
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and colored crayon, over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a Venetian canal scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The viewer sees both sides of the canal, with tall buildings obscuring the horizon. A bridge stretches across the water, with loosely sketched figures. The art style is characterized by expressive strokes, creating a dynamic and lively feel. The color palette includes rich reds, yellows, blues for the buildings, and greens, blues for the canal. Light blue strokes represent the sky.

artworks.title: Venice, Boats
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash and blue, yellow and brown crayon
artworks.description: The image depicts a bridge over a canal in a city resembling Venice. Buildings obscure the horizon line behind the bridge, while the sun is depicted in the top left corner. The style features loose and expressive brushstrokes, using bold pen or ink lines for a sketch-like effect. The color palette includes browns, yellows, black, and hints of blue on a beige background. The architecture, boats, and bridge structures are rendered with dynamic, quick, linear strokes, capturing the lively atmosphere of a canal scene.

artworks.title: Street in the Bronx
artworks.medium: crayon
artworks.description: The image shows a sunlit street with a cluster of red and orange houses under a bright blue sky. Bold pastel brushstrokes depict a sense of movement, with vibrant colors and a sidewalk on the left leading into the scene. Utility poles line the street, casting shadows.

artworks.title: Woman's Head
artworks.medium: black chalk on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's head and partial upper chest in profile. The person is facing to the left side of the picture. Their facial features include a nose, chin, lips, and eye. The person's hair is short and wavy, covered by a cap or headdress. The drawing style appears soft and textured. The person is not wearing visible clothing apart from the headdress. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Illustration for "Bird Beast"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear-like animal observing a platypus and a small bird on a rocky surface with surrounding vegetation. The drawing features a large, dark-furred creature on the right side, resting its front paw on a rock, with a curious expression as it gazes at the platypus in the center. The platypus appears to be looking sideways at the smaller bird on the left, which is perched on a stone. Around the animals, there is sparse vegetation, including leafy plants and wildflowers. The background is in a muted, earthy tone. This scene captures a moment of stillness and interaction among the animals, depicted with an emphasis on texture and detail.

artworks.title: San Remo
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a three-masted sailing vessel viewed from a slight angle on calm water. The high horizon line is just below the distant hills and structures in the background. The ship is depicted in a delicate pencil style with fine lines and shading. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, using shades of gray. A small rowboat is tethered to the ship, and there are buildings and hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Moat at Fort Marion, Florida
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on wove tan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a coastal fortification, with a wall extending towards the center. The perspective is slightly elevated, allowing the expanse beyond the wall to be seen, including a low horizon where the sea meets the sky. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition. The style is delicate and precise, using pencil and wash for a textured effect. The color palette includes earth tones and grays. Two figures are walking close to us, with another pair visible near the horizon line. The sky has subtle tones and streaks indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Fort Marion, Florida
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The viewpoint is elevated, showing a courtyard with a stone archway. The sky is shaded with horizontal pencil strokes and sketchy birds in flight. The scene includes weathered structures, cannonballs stacked neatly, and an old-fashioned cannon near the archway. Architectural details show rough-textured walls and small windows, portrayed with quick pencil strokes. Two small figures walk under the arch. The drawing features a monochromatic pencil sketch, using shading to add depth and define areas, creating a historic ambiance.

artworks.title: Idyll
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash and white heightening on brown paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a person playing a wind instrument such as a flute. The person is depicted from a side view, with one arm raised to hold the instrument near the mouth. The figure has short, wavy hair pulled back and is dressed in a long, flowing garment. Surrounding the person are four lions seated in a semi-circle, looking towards the musician. The lions have detailed facial features and prominent manes. The background features a natural setting with outlines of trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Bernini Fountain, Rome [recto]
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on two sheets of joined wove paper
artworks.description: This painting depicts a street scene under an archway. The arch frames a view of a street with a stone fountain in the middle ground, sculpted with a figure seated on it. In the foreground, a dog is lying on the cobblestone street, observing a loaded donkey. A barrel is partially visible nearby. The background shows surrounding buildings with windows and facades, reflecting a historic urban setting. The style resembles that of F.O.C. Darley.

artworks.title: Chef Tossing Pancakes and Group of Four Men [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on two joined sheets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with several individuals engaged in different activities. The drawing, sketched in pencil on paper, depicts figures on both the left and right pages. On the left side, a person is reaching upward with a pan. A sweeping arc with decorative elements is above. The right side shows loosely sketched figures clustered closely. The drawing style suggests quick, fluid motions, emphasizing spontaneity and movement. Shading and lines give depth and energy to the composition, capturing the lively nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Mission Dolores, San Francisco
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: This image depicts a frontal view of a church structure, showing the top of its facade. The apex of the roof serves as a visual line. A cross crowns the building at the peak of the roof. The style is a pencil sketch with visible stroke marks that define the texture and form of the building. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily shades of gray. Close to us, an arched doorway is visible near the base of the structure, while in the distance, a window with grid patterns is shown under the roofline. Softly outlined figures or shadows to the right suggest the presence of trees or foliage. The text above the structure is handwritten in Latin.

artworks.title: Josie
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two studies of a lioness. The artwork features two sketches of a lioness, one lying down in profile, showing her face and body, and another sketch focusing on the lioness's head and facial features. The drawing is done in pencil with soft shading and bold lines to emphasize the lioness's form, fur texture, and body lines.

artworks.title: Panther and Young Lion Studies
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various sketches of large feline heads and figures. The artwork features multiple sketches of panther and young lion heads in profile and different poses. In the upper left corner, there are loosely sketched outlines of a pair of lions, slightly overlapping one another. The central part of the drawing highlights a more detailed render of a lioness's head, with attention given to the intricate facial features and the surrounding mane area, as well as a shaded study within a circular frame. In the lower left, a panther's head is depicted in profile with more defined lines. Text annotations such as "Panther" and "Young Lions" alongside the sketches provide insight into the subject matter and focus of the artist. The sketchy and textured lines evoke a sense of movement and study characteristic of preparatory drawings.

artworks.title: Woman's Head
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: The image depicts a simple line drawing of a person's head and shoulders in a minimalistic style. The figure faces left in a side profile, with basic facial features, simple hair lines, and a vague outline of clothing. The drawing is on a light brown paper background with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: graphite on brown paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing depicting a person standing in a confident pose with their hands in their pockets. The person's head is large compared to the body, with exaggerated facial features such as a curled mustache and goatee. The eyes are suggested. The hair is wavy. The person is dressed in a formal outfit with a suit, jacket, waistcoat, and trousers. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain. There is a handwritten note next to the figure on aged paper with worn edges.

artworks.title: Landscape near Washington, Connecticut
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape sketch viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The terrain slopes gently upward to the right, where a stand of trees is located. The horizon line is indicated by diminishing details and lower contrast in the distance. There is open space and patches of vegetation on the left side. The sketch is in soft black and white tones with varied pencil strokes to depict textures and undulations. The monochromatic palette highlights light and shadow, with a warm beige background adding a subtle warmth. The trees lead the gaze towards the distance, with sparse vegetation and dusty ground in the foreground.

artworks.title: Market, Mexico, Indian Woman Buying Trinkets
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of a market scene. The image depicts a busy and vibrant environment filled with market-like items in various colors. The style is sketch-like, with some indistinct lines suggesting movement and activity. There are colorful fabrics or goods hanging from above, and an assortment of shapes resembling market goods or trinkets spread over cloth-covered tables. The background contains darker, indistinct strokes, adding depth and indicating the presence of surroundings or further stalls.

artworks.title: Pond Edge
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil body of water with a dense grouping of trees in the background. The horizon is not distinctly visible, but suggested around the tops of the trees. The drawing is detailed with pencil brushstrokes, depicting the foliage and tree trunks. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. The water reflects the trees, and a branch extends into the scene on the right.

artworks.title: Shipwreck in Storm
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The artwork portrays a stormy seascape with churning waves and a dramatic sky. The horizon is low, emphasizing the turbulent waters and sky. In the distance, a ship can be seen among the waves. The brushstrokes are energetic and convey movement. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, accentuating light and shadow contrasts. Vague forms near the viewer suggest parts of a ship or debris in the chaotic sea.

artworks.title: Deep Valley in Mountainous Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows towering, sloping hills or mountains that create a U-shaped composition. The horizon is not visible, obscured by the mountainous terrain dominating the upper part of the image. Loose brushwork is used to depict rocky surfaces, with a monochromatic color palette of varying browns and sepia. A figure is silhouetted against the landscape, with a moody and atmospheric tone emphasized by light areas in the sky above.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with rolling hills and a high horizon. In the foreground, there is a cluster of trees painted with loose brushstrokes. The land slopes down towards a body of water. The painting features expressive brushwork and a muted color palette dominated by earthy browns and greys.
